description: A Drupal form class for confirming the installation of experimental themes, including dependency handling and user messaging.

classes.name: ThemeExperimentalConfirmForm
classes.description: A form class for confirming the installation of experimental themes in Drupal, extending ConfirmFormBase.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting theme list and installer services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Returns the confirmation question for the form.

methods.name: getCancelUrl
methods.description: Provides the URL to redirect to if the operation is canceled.

methods.name: getConfirmText
methods.description: Returns the text for the confirmation button.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides a description message for the form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form, including theme dependency checks and messaging.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, installs themes, updates configuration, and manages messaging.
